knowledge.text: The first step is a conversation about the client's goals, site, scope and priorities. Design, engineering and pre-construction planning follow as needed.
Automatic quoting is currently disabled. A team member reviews the scope before providing an estimate.
Clients can share existing plans, a screenshot or a link. Plans and permits are not prerequisites for an initial conversation.

consultation.description: The initial consultation with a team member is free. Design, permits, engineering and construction are separately scoped; do not describe those services as free.
